solutions.title: Check all wall pairs
solutions.strategy: Compute the contained area for every pair of positions.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every left index is paired with every later right index.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only loop indexes and the best area are stored.

solutions.title: Move the shorter wall inward
solutions.strategy: Start at both ends and discard the shorter wall after each area check.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each pointer only moves inward, so each index is visited at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The algorithm keeps two pointers and a scalar best area.
